# ONTO

> ONTO is an independent institute that measures epistemic discipline in AI models and trains it into the weights of open models. Results, failures included, are published with their numbers.

- [Method](https://ontostandard.org/method/): what is measured and how results are accepted (ONTO:2610.0007)
- [Lab](https://ontostandard.org/lab/): students, their exams and the latest results
- [Demo](https://ontostandard.org/demo/): recorded answers of a regular model and the ONTO student
- [Archive](https://ontostandard.org/archive/): numbered, dated documents; corrections come as new versions
- [Archive catalogue](https://ontostandard.org/archive/archive.json) · [Live numbers](https://ontostandard.org/status.json)

Closed by design: the canon (GOLD), training data and recipe, trained weights, judges' code, held-out question sets.
Contact: council@ontostandard.org
